en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a cobblestone street lined with multi‑story buildings leading toward a tall church tower with a pointed roof and arched windows. A few people and a horse‑drawn cart are visible on the street. Handwritten cursive text is present at the bottom and along the left side. Printed red text near the bottom reads the location, and there is a date written in ink.
